name: Manken! I! My! Girls!
original_name: まんけん！アイ!マイ!ガールズ
source:
Mairu and friends have successfully re-opened the Cherry Tree High Comedy Club, but now they actually need to act like a club! Mairu’s nemesis Chitose hasn’t run out of tricks to catch them out just yet, so they’ll need to be careful! But Chitose isn’t the only problem that Mairu and friends have to deal with… A rival club is competing for the spot of number one entertainment, and a new transfer student will deeply affect the Comedy Club line-up!

[From [url=http://cherrytreehigh.com/cthimg]Official site[/url]]
translation:
舞瑠与朋友们成功重开了Cherry Tree High喜剧社，但现在他们必须真正像个社团一样活动！舞瑠的宿敌千岁还没有放弃抓住她们的把柄，所以大家必须小心！然而，千岁并不是舞瑠一行人唯一要面对的问题……一个竞争社团正在争夺第一娱乐社团的位置，而一名新转学生也将深刻影响喜剧社的阵容！

[译自[url=http://cherrytreehigh.com/cthimg]官方网站[/url]]
